label: layout
js: (() => { window.measure = (two) => { game.hold(true); game.autoPause(false); game.setTouch(true); game.start({ two, diff: 'easy', skipReady: true }); game.step(0.2); const M = game.M; const pts = []; for (const [x, y] of [[-1.3, -1.3], [M.W + 0.3, -1.3], [-1.3, M.H + 0.3], [M.W + 0.3, M.H + 0.3]]) pts.push(game.toScreen(x, y, 0), game.toScreen(x, y, 0.6)); const board = { l: Math.min(...pts.map(p => p.x)), r: Math.max(...pts.map(p => p.x)), t: Math.min(...pts.map(p => p.y)), b: Math.max(...pts.map(p => p.y)) }; const els = ['kit-help-btn', 'kit-lang-btn', 'pad0', 'act0', 'budBtn', 'pad1', 'act1'].map(id => { const e = document.getElementById(id); const r = e && e.getBoundingClientRect(); return r && r.width && getComputedStyle(e).display !== 'none' && getComputedStyle(e).visibility !== 'hidden' ? { id, l: r.left, r: r.right, t: r.top, b: r.bottom, w: r.width } : null; }).filter(Boolean); const hit = (a, b) => a.l < b.r - 1 && b.l < a.r - 1 && a.t < b.b - 1 && b.t < a.b - 1; const probs = []; for (const e of els) { if (hit(e, board)) probs.push(e.id + ' covers the arena'); if (e.l < -1 || e.t < -1 || e.r > innerWidth + 1 || e.b > innerHeight + 1) probs.push(e.id + ' off screen'); if (e.w < (e.id.startsWith('kit-') ? 40 : 44)) probs.push(e.id + ' small ' + e.w); } for (let a = 0; a < els.length; a++) for (let b = a + 1; b < els.length; b++) if (hit(els[a], els[b])) probs.push(els[a].id + ' overlaps ' + els[b].id); const hud = document.querySelector('.bars').getBoundingClientRect(); if (board.t < hud.bottom - 30) probs.push('arena under the HUD ' + Math.round(board.t) + ' < ' + Math.round(hud.bottom)); if (board.l < 0 || board.r > innerWidth || board.b > innerHeight) probs.push('arena off screen'); const cell = (board.r - board.l) / (M.W + 2.6); return innerWidth + 'x' + innerHeight + (two ? ' 2P' : ' 1P') + ' arena ' + M.W + 'x' + M.H + ' cell ' + cell.toFixed(0) + 'px ' + JSON.stringify(probs); }; return 'ok'; })()

label: desktop keys
js: (() => { game.setTouch(false); game.start({ diff: 'normal', skipReady: true }); game.step(0.2); const b = document.getElementById('budBtn').getBoundingClientRect(); const M = game.M; const c = game.toScreen(M.W + 0.3, M.H + 0.3, 0); return 'companion button left ' + Math.round(b.left) + ', arena right ' + Math.round(c.x); })()

label: title portrait
js: (() => { game.setTouch(true); game.menu(); game.step(0.5); const s = document.getElementById('title'); return 'scroll ' + s.scrollHeight + ' / ' + s.clientHeight; })()

label: title landscape
js: (() => { game.menu(); game.step(0.3); const s = document.getElementById('title'); return 'scroll ' + s.scrollHeight + ' / ' + s.clientHeight; })()
